## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: driving situations: roundabouts, metered ramps, diverging diamond interchanges, traffic stops, deer and funeral processions
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The one-lane roundabout page is a labeled diagram; only its clearly worded callouts for bicyclists and pedestrians were used, and street names in the drawing are not restated [A02].
The two-lane roundabout diagram labels several lane-use combinations for different entries; only the summary callouts for left, right and straight-through traffic were used [A03].
The diverging diamond entry points to a linked page for more information; that page was not followed [A04].
The list of diverging diamond interchange locations reflects this edition and can change, which is isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Wisconsin Motorists Handbook prints 2026 on its front cover and form number BDS126 with 2026 on its back cover; it is a yearly-dated handbook with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
